## [Problem 1: Counting DNA Nucleotides](https://rosalind.info/problems/dna/)


```python
DNA_string = ""

A, T, C, G = 0, 0, 0, 0

for nt in DNA_string:
    if nt == "A":
        A += 1
    elif nt == "T":
        T += 1
    elif nt == "C":
        C += 1
    elif nt == "G":
        G += 1

print(A, C, G, T)
```

## [Problem 2: Transcribing DNA into RNA](https://rosalind.info/problems/rna/)


```python
from Bio.Seq import Seq

RNAstring = Seq("")
mRNA = RNAstring.transcribe()

print(mRNA)
```

## Problem 3: [Complementing a strand of DNA](https://rosalind.info/problems/revc/)


```python
from Bio.Seq import Seq

DNA = Seq("")
rev_comp = DNA.reverse_complement()

print(rev_comp)
```

##  [Problem 4: Hamming Distance](https://rosalind.info/problems/ba1g/)

```python
String1 = "GAGCCTACTAACGGGAT"
String2 = "CATCGTAATGACGGCCT"
count = 0

for nt1, nt2 in zip(String1, String2):
    if nt1 != nt2:
        count += 1

print(count)
```
